content.storyline: The 4-7 Ravens, fourth in the AFC North, visit the 4-6 Texans, second in the AFC South. Baltimore is coming off a 35-33 loss to Carolina, while Houston beat Indianapolis 26-3 in Week 11.
matchup_notes: Baltimore is 4-7 and fourth in the AFC North; Houston is 4-6 and second in the AFC South.
The Ravens enter on a six-game losing streak.
In Week 11, Baltimore lost 35-33 to Carolina, while Houston beat Indianapolis 26-3.
Houston has 33 sacks, ranked second; Baltimore has 19, ranked 22nd.
